verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents a hosted KYC/KYB solution that platforms integrate for all user types, which covers verification without building forms. It also offers a pre-built embeddable UI component for registering bank account details as a Recipient, alongside user management for compliance. missing for 10: evidence of terms-acceptance handling during onboarding, detailed API-level user/legal-entity creation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted onboarding flows.
